ModMetaData.name: Rimlink
ModMetaData.author: Asofwar
ModMetaData.description:
Persistent multiplayer: your own colony on a planet shared with other players through a dedicated Rimlink server. A colony is frozen while its owner is offline. Raids and visits work at any time, or live when both players are online; the market, gifts and trades go through server escrow.
You need a Rimlink server to play: ask your admin for an address or run your own.
Open source (MIT): https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink
